zh.title: 颱風白海豚影響 華航調整8月10日上海航班
zh.summary: 受颱風白海豚影響，中華航空宣布2026年8月10日松山往返上海虹橋CI201/CI202航班取消，桃園與高雄往返上海浦東航班延後並放大機型。此外，國籍航空亦針對沖繩航線採取放大機型與加開班機等疏運措施。
body: 受颱風白海豚影響，中華航空於2026年8月9日宣布調整8月10日台灣往返上海航班。其中，CI201與CI202松山往返上海虹橋航班取消；CI501與CI502桃園往返上海浦東航班，以及CI583與CI584高雄往返上海浦東航班則予以延後，並調整放大機型執行。
為因應颱風對沖繩航線的影響，長榮航空於8月9日將桃園往返沖繩航班之機型放大為波音777-300ER，以利疏運旅客。星宇航空則於8月9日與10日安排沖繩加班機，包括台北往返沖繩之JX1870與JX1871航班，協助疏運受影響旅客。
歷史紀錄顯示，星宇航空先前於8月8日因颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區，曾取消當日台灣往返沖繩之全部航班，包含原訂之加班機JX1870與JX1871。

en.title: Typhoon White Dolphin Prompts China Airlines Shanghai Flight Adjustments
en.summary: Due to the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines announced adjustments for its flights between Taiwan and Shanghai on August 10, cancelling flights CI201 and CI202 between Taipei Songshan and Shanghai Hongqiao. Additionally, services CI501 and CI502 from Taoyuan to Shanghai Pudong, alongside CI583 and CI584 from Kaohsiung to Shanghai Pudong, will be delayed and operated with larger aircraft. Other Taiwanese carriers, including EVA Air and STARLUX Airlines, have also deployed upscaled aircraft and extra flights to accommodate passengers affected on Okinawa routes.
body: China Airlines announced operational adjustments for its Taiwan to Shanghai flights on August 10 in response to Typhoon White Dolphin. Under the revised schedule, flights CI201 and CI202 between Taipei Songshan Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport are cancelled. Meanwhile, flights CI501 and CI502 operating between Taoyuan and Shanghai Pudong, as well as CI583 and CI584 between Kaohsiung and Shanghai Pudong, will experience departure delays and utilize upscaled aircraft capacity.

To assist passenger transportation on Okinawa routes affected by the typhoon, EVA Air assigned larger Boeing 777-300ER aircraft for its Taoyuan-Okinawa flights on August 9. STARLUX Airlines also scheduled relief flights JX1870 and JX1871 between Taipei and Okinawa on August 9 and August 10 to clear passenger backlog. Historical records show STARLUX Airlines had previously cancelled all Taiwan-Okinawa flights on August 8, including scheduled relief flights JX1870 and JX1871.
